verses.text: "These are the tribes, listed by name. At the northern border, along the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath, as far as Hazar Enan on the border of Damascus, next to Hamath, running from east to west, Dan will have one portion.
Next to Dan's border, from east to west, Asher will have one portion.
Next to Asher's border, from east to west, Naphtali will have one portion.
Next to Naphtali's border, from east to west, Manasseh will have one portion.
Next to Manasseh's border, from east to west, Ephraim will have one portion.
Next to Ephraim's border, from east to west, Reuben will have one portion.
Next to Reuben's border, from east to west, Judah will have one portion.

"Next to Judah's border, from east to west, will be the special portion you set apart. It will be twenty-five thousand cubits wide and as long as one of the tribal portions from east to west. The sanctuary will be in the middle of it.
"The special portion you set apart for the LORD will be twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide.

This will be the holy portion for the priests. It will be twenty-five thousand cubits long on the north side, ten thousand cubits wide on the west side, ten thousand cubits wide on the east side, and twenty-five thousand cubits long on the south side. The sanctuary of the LORD will be in the middle of it.
It will be for the priests set apart as holy, the descendants of Zadok, who faithfully served me and did not wander off when the people of Israel wandered off, as the Levites did.
It will be their own special gift from the holy portion of the land, a most holy area next to the land of the Levites.

"Next to the priests' land, the Levites will have an area twenty-five thousand cubits long and ten thousand cubits wide. Its whole length will be twenty-five thousand cubits and its width ten thousand.
They must not sell or trade any of it. This best part of the land must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the LORD.
"The remaining area, five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand cubits long, will be for common use by the city, for homes and for open land. The city will be in the middle of it.

These will be its measurements: the north side four thousand five hundred cubits, the south side four thousand five hundred cubits, the east side four thousand five hundred cubits, and the west side four thousand five hundred cubits.
The city will have open land around it: two hundred fifty cubits on the north, two hundred fifty on the south, two hundred fifty on the east, and two hundred fifty on the west.

What is left of the length beside the holy portion will be ten thousand cubits on the east and ten thousand cubits on the west, running alongside the holy portion. Its crops will feed the workers of the city.
The workers of the city, from all the tribes of Israel, will farm it.
The whole special portion will be a square, twenty-five thousand cubits on each side. You will set it apart as a holy portion, along with the city's property.

"What remains on both sides of the holy portion and the city's property will belong to the prince. It will stretch east from the twenty-five thousand cubits of the holy portion to the eastern border, and west from the twenty-five thousand cubits to the western border, alongside the tribal portions. It will belong to the prince. The holy portion, with the sanctuary of the temple, will be in the middle of it.
So the land of the Levites and the city's property will be in the middle of the prince's land. The prince's land will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.
"As for the rest of the tribes: from east to west, Benjamin will have one portion.
Next to Benjamin's border, from east to west, Simeon will have one portion.
Next to Simeon's border, from east to west, Issachar will have one portion.
Next to Issachar's border, from east to west, Zebulun will have one portion.
Next to Zebulun's border, from east to west, Gad will have one portion.
The southern border of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.
"This is the land you are to divide by lot as an inheritance for the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions, says the Lord GOD.
"These will be the exits of the city. The north side will be four thousand five hundred cubits long.
The gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah, and the gate of Levi.
The east side will be four thousand five hundred cubits long, with three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin, and the gate of Dan.
The south side will be four thousand five hundred cubits long, with three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar, and the gate of Zebulun.
The west side will be four thousand five hundred cubits long, with three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher, and the gate of Naphtali.
"The distance all the way around the city will be eighteen thousand cubits. And from that day on, the name of the city will be: The LORD Is There."
